_description: Luong nghiep vu nhieu buoc: muc nhat quan + cach bu tru + VI SAO.
_note: Tang CURATED (co kiem bang GENERATED). Cot 'vi_sao' KHONG cong cu nao suy ra duoc — day la ly do tep nay khong hoan toan tu sinh.

flow_name.scope: service nao, mot giao dich hay nhieu
flow_name.compensation: that bai het luot thu thi lam gi — phai la hanh dong nghiep vu CO VET
flow_name.why: vi sao chon muc nhat quan nay — BAT BUOC, khong duoc bo trong

xac_thuc_can_bo_lien_service.scope: Hai service moi yeu cau cua can bo: service-{documents,finance,comms,petitions,platform} (platform tu 02/10/2026: tuyen logo + banner web-admin cua xa, ADR 0069) goi IdentityService.ResolveStaffPrincipal (proto/vigov/identity/v1/identity.proto), roi tu quyet dinh tai cho bang authz.RequirePermission / AnyAuthenticated. Khong ghi du lieu nghiep vu nao trong buoc nay.
xac_thuc_can_bo_lien_service.compensation: Khong co gi de bu: buoc nay khong ghi. Goi that bai (UNAVAILABLE) thi ben goi tra 503 va KHONG dung principal nao — tuyet doi khong duoc doc thanh 'khong co principal', vi nhu the mot su co cua identity bien thanh 'moi nguoi bi dang xuat' va can bo duoc bao di dang nhap lai qua dung cai service dang hong.
xac_thuc_can_bo_lien_service.why: Doc thang moi yeu cau, KHONG cache, va day la cho duy nhat de tranh luan voi quyet dinh ay. Luat 5 bat bien 4 doi mot phien bi thu hoi phai het tac dung o yeu cau ke tiep; ADR 0010 chot ha tang du lieu chi co PostgreSQL nen khong co cache dung chung, identity lai chay nhieu replica, tuc moi cache deu la PER PROCESS va mot lan thu hoi do replica A phuc vu khong co duong nao bao cho ban sao cua replica B. Mot TTL du ngan cung giu phien da thu hoi, tai khoan da khoa va vai tro da rut tiep tuc chay het TTL tren moi tien trinh khong phuc vu lan thu hoi do — hong im lang, khong test nao do. Lap luan nay da duoc viet mot lan cho duong cong dan o service-identity/internal/store/phien_cong_dan.go; day la cung mot lap luan cho duong can bo. Cai gia phai tra la mot vong mang cho MOI yeu cau cua can bo toi bon service ay, va do la cai gia duoc chon, khong phai cai gia bi bo sot. Dieu KIEN de mo lai cau hoi cache: co mot kenh thu hoi toi duoc moi replica cua moi service — day la ha tang chua ton tai va la viec phai hoi nguoi dung, khong phai viec toi uu trong luc viet ma.

xac_thuc_van_hanh_lien_service.scope: Hai service moi yeu cau cua NGUOI VAN HANH ViHAT: service-platform (bien HTTP duy nhat cua khu van hanh, tren OPERATOR_HOST) kiem chu ky token op1. tai cho, roi goi OperatorService.ResolveOperatorSession (proto/vigov/identity/v1/operator.proto) tra so phien van hanh cua service-identity, roi tu quyet dinh tai cho theo khoa ops.*. RPC KHONG mang xa (nam trong core/grpcx.methodsWithoutTenant). Buoc nay KHONG ghi du lieu nghiep vu; no chi lam moi operator_session.last_seen_at (dong ho nhan roi 5 phut), khong ghi vet. Dang nhap, dang ky TOTP, doi mat khau, tao lai ma khoi phuc la MOT giao dich trong identity moi lan, khong phai luong nhieu service.
xac_thuc_van_hanh_lien_service.compensation: Khong co gi de bu: buoc nay khong ghi du lieu nghiep vu. Goi that bai (UNAVAILABLE, FAILED_PRECONDITION) thi platform tra 503 va KHONG dung principal nao — khong doc thanh 'chua dang nhap', khong dung ket qua cu. Identity ngung thi khu van hanh ngung: dong kin, dung nguyen tac fail closed.
xac_thuc_van_hanh_lien_service.why: Nguoi dung chot 01/10/2026 (ADR 0048 muc 01/10 #2): lai, KHONG cache. Chi kiem chu ky thi gay hai dieu da chot 28/09: nhan roi 5 phut khong do duoc (TCVN 14423) va thu hoi phai cho toi han tuyet doi 8 gio. Cache bi loai cung ly do duong can bo: ADR 0010 chi co PostgreSQL, identity nhieu replica nen cache nao cung PER PROCESS va mot lan thu hoi khong co duong toi ban sao cua replica khac. Gia da chon va da noi voi nguoi dung: mot loi goi gRPC moi yeu cau van hanh (vai nguoi ViHAT tren mot host, khong bao gio la luu luong cua xa), va khoa ky van hanh nam o hai service nen xoay khoa cham ca hai. Duong su kien + read model bi loai: do tre roi thang vao mot phien da thu hoi van dung duoc tren sieu du lieu cua MOI xa.
xac_thuc_van_hanh_lien_service.adr: kb/10-decisions/0048-khu-van-hanh-vihat-trong-web-admin.md (Chot 01/10/2026 #2; Chot buoc 1 va sua sau ra bao mat) · kb/10-decisions/0012-grpc-boundary-contract.md (quyet dinh 1) · kb/10-decisions/0025-xac-thuc-giua-cac-service.md

tinh_han_xu_ly_luc_tiep_nhan.scope: Hai service trong mot lan tiep nhan: service-petitions (Phan anh) va service-documents (Van ban den) goi IdentityService.ResolveDeadlines (proto/vigov/identity/v1/identity.proto, chot 22/09/2026), roi TU MINH ghi ban ghi nghiep vu + dong nhat ky trong MOT giao dich cua chinh no (luat 6 bat bien 3). MOT CHANG chu khong phai hai: RPC ay doc bang `sla` (bao lau, migration 0008, ADR 0029) VA lich lam viec cua xa (luc nao, migration 0006) roi tra ve MOC HAN da cong xong - nguoi dung chot 22/09/2026 tra moc han chu khong tra so gio, vi tra so gio thi petitions VA documents moi ben phai tu cong gio lam viec va ADR 0007 cam hai ban cai dat cua phep tinh ay. AdvanceWorkingHours van con, cho ben goi tu giu so gio va khong doc `sla`. VOI PHIEU PHAN ANH DAY LA HAI LAN GOI O HAI HANH VI KHAC NHAU, khong phai mot (ADR 0028 quyet dinh E): `han_tiep_nhan` an dinh luc sinh dong (doc dong MAC DINH, vi chua ai biet linh vuc), `han_xu_ly_xong` an dinh luc can bo chot linh vuc (doc dong CUA LINH VUC AY). NGOAI LE TU 29/09/2026 (ADR 0050 diem 1): phieu Mini App MA DAN DA CHON LINH VUC (`field`) thi CA HAI HAN an dinh LUC TAO PHIEU bang MOT lan goi ResolveDeadlines cho linh vuc ay, ghi ro ca hai dong ho; TRUOC lan goi ay petitions kiem linh vuc voi bo ma tang 1 (PlatformService.ListPetitionFields, ADR 0060, cache <= 60 giay) va cong tac tang 2 cua xa (`nhan_linh_vuc.enabled`) — `platform` khong toi duoc thi TU CHOI 503, khong ghi gi, khong cap ma, dung nhu nhanh identity that bai (service-petitions/internal/app/gui_phan_anh.go). Phieu khong co `field` giu nguyen hinh dang hai lan goi o tren. Moi lan goi la mot ranh gioi rieng cua cung hinh dang nay: goi xong roi moi mo giao dich. Loi goi gRPC nam NGOAI giao dich ay va phai xong TRUOC khi giao dich mo: mot vong mang giu trong long mot giao dich CSDL la giu khoa hang qua thoi gian cua mot dich vu khac. Ban than loi goi KHONG ghi gi ca — no doc cau hinh lich lam viec cua xa (lich_lam_viec, ngay_nghi_le, ngay_lam_bu, service-identity/migrations/0006_lich_lam_viec.sql).
tinh_han_xu_ly_luc_tiep_nhan.compensation: Khong co gi de bu, vi den luc that bai chua co gi duoc ghi: goi that bai (UNAVAILABLE, FAILED_PRECONDITION, INVALID_ARGUMENT) thi TIEP NHAN THAT BAI — khong ghi dong phan anh nao, KHONG CAP MA TRA CUU (luat 7 bat bien 3: ma da phat thi khong bao gio phat lai, nen khong duoc phat ra roi vut di), va cong dan nhan loi 'chua gui duoc, xin gui lai'. Hanh dong nghiep vu CO VET o day khong phai o phia ban ghi ma o phia van hanh: 'kenh cong dan dang tu choi tiep nhan' la mot su co cua xa, phai duoc dem va bao dong, khong duoc chim thanh loi le te cua tung nguoi. TUYET DOI KHONG duoc chon duong 'nhan phieu truoc, tinh han sau': mot phieu nam trong CSDL khong co sla_deadline la mot cam ket chua ai dem, trong khi moi bao cao dung han/qua han van dem no; luat 10 bat bien 2 doi han duoc tinh MOT LAN LUC TIEP NHAN va luu lai, nen 'tinh sau' la tinh tu mot thoi diem khac va tra ve mot con so khac.
tinh_han_xu_ly_luc_tiep_nhan.why: Manh vi ban than han xu ly la thu phai TON TAI cung luc voi ban ghi, khong phai thu duoc phep toi muon. Han la cam ket cua chinh quyen noi voi cong dan ngay luc tiep nhan (luat 10 bat bien 1, 2), nen khong co muc tre nao la chap nhan duoc: tre mot giay cung co nghia la co mot khoang thoi gian ma phieu ton tai ma khong ai biet no den han luc nao. Doc bang mot loi goi dong bo la duong RE, khong phai duong dat: goi MOT LAN cho MOI BAN GHI DUOC TIEP NHAN — khong phai moi yeu cau, khong phai moi dong danh sach — vi luat 10 bat bien 2 bat han duoc luu lai, nen moi lan doc ve sau chi doc mot cot TIMESTAMPTZ va khong goi gi nua. Vi the cung KHONG CO CACHE, va o day cache khong chi thua ma con SAI: ADR 0007 quyet dinh 6 chot cau hinh doi thi KHONG HOI TO, tuc ban ghi tiep nhan SAU khi xa sua lich phai duoc tinh theo lich MOI — dung mot ban sao cu la lam nguoc lai dung dieu ay, im lang, tren bat ky tien trinh nao con giu ban sao. Do la cung cai bay khong-co-duong-thu-hoi da duoc viet mot lan o service-identity/internal/store/phien_cong_dan.go, lan nay roi vao mot cam ket da noi voi dan chu khong phai mot phien dang nhap. Duong SU KIEN cung bi loai vi ly do nay: mot read model cua lich lam viec o phia petitions la dung mot ban sao co do tre — va do tre ay roi thang vao con so hen voi dan. Duong THU BA (petitions tu doc CSDL cua identity) la thu luat 2 cam #2. THEM MOT DUONG NUA BI LOAI, va no la duong de di nhat: xa CHUA CAU HINH `sla` thi KHONG duoc lay mot con so mac dinh. ResolveDeadlines tra FAILED_PRECONDITION, va hom nay do la cau tra loi CUA MOI XA - migration 0008 co y khong gieo dong nao va buoc khoi tao xa chua ton tai. Mot mac dinh o day (24 gio, hay 16 dong cua docs/ui-ux/14-cau-hinh.md muc 8) la phan mem tu hua ho co quan, va loi hua ay van den tai cong dan nhu the chinh quyen da noi (luat 10 cam #3). Ben goi nhan loi thi TIEP NHAN THAT BAI, dung nhu doan bu tru o tren - khong co nhanh nao khac.

thong_bao_cong_dan_khi_phieu_doi_trang_t.scope: Hai service, HAI giao dich rieng biet, noi voi nhau bang mot su kien. (1) service-petitions ghi lan chuyen trang thai + dong nhat ky trong MOT giao dich cua chinh no (luat 6 bat bien 3), roi SAU KHI COMMIT moi phat su kien `petitions.status_changed.v1` (luoc do: proto/vigov/petitions/v1/events.proto; phong bi: core/events.Envelope, tenant_id nam o phong bi). Phat TRONG LONG giao dich la loi kinh dien o day: consumer doc mot phieu CSDL chua lo ra, va hong ay phu thuoc thoi diem nen moi test van xanh. (2) service-comms nhan su kien va ghi mot dong `thong_bao_gui_cong_dan` o trang thai `cho-gui` (service-comms/migrations/0004) — dong so duoc ghi LUC NGHIA VU PHAT SINH, khong phai luc tin di duoc — roi adapter OA cua xa moi thu gui. Hai buoc ay cung khong nam trong mot giao dich voi nhau: lan gui la mot loi goi ra ben ngoai, va giu mot giao dich CSDL mo qua mot loi goi mang la giu khoa hang qua thoi gian cua Zalo.
thong_bao_cong_dan_khi_phieu_doi_trang_t.max_lag: Muc tieu vai giay khi kenh khoe; tran thuc te la so lan thu con lai roi toi dead letter. KHONG co cam ket nao voi cong dan ve do tre cua rieng tin nhan, va dung bia ra mot con so o day: cam ket cua xa la HAN TIEP NHAN / HAN XU LY XONG (luat 10, ADR 0028), va hai han ay khong do bang duong nay.
thong_bao_cong_dan_khi_phieu_doi_trang_t.compensation: KHONG BAO GIO hoan tac luot ghi nghiep vu. Day la phan khong duoc thoa hiep: ADR 0006 he qua 4 — mot phieu khong bao gio bi tu choi chi vi tin nhan khong gui duoc; het luot thu thi thu bi mat la MOT LAN BAO, khong phai mot phieu, va vut mot phieu de cuu mot tin nhan la doi mot ho so hanh chinh lay mot thong bao. Bu tru la hanh dong nghiep vu CO VET, khong phai mot lan rollback im lang: (a) het luot thu -> dong so chuyen `that-bai` + vao dead letter + co 'chua bao duoc' CAN BO NHIN THAY, de mot cam ket that bai khong lan vao im lang (ADR 0006 he qua 3); (b) xa chua cau hinh OA -> `chua-cau-hinh-kenh`, KHONG day vao vong thu lai, vi vong ay khong bao gio thanh cong va no chi lam co bao dong tro thanh tieng on; (c) nguoi bu tru la CAN BO: bao lai cong dan bang duong khac roi dong so giu nguyen vet 'da bao ngoai he thong'. Phat lai su kien KHONG sinh tin thu hai: khoa chong trung cua comms la khoa cua SU THAT (`doi_tuong_loai|doi_tuong_ma|moc|lan|nguoi_nhan_ma|kenh`, domain.KhoaLanGui), nen mot producer phat lai duoi mot id moi cung roi vao dung mot dong; va truong `occurrence` trong su kien la thu giu cho lan DONG THU HAI sau khi cong dan mo lai phieu (ADR 0008) khong bi nuot nhu mot ban trung.
thong_bao_cong_dan_khi_phieu_doi_trang_t.why: Cuoi cung, va lua chon nay da co chu ky: ADR 0006 he qua 4. Dong bo o day nghia la lan tiep nhan phieu goi thang sang comms va cho Zalo tra loi — tuc kenh tiep dan cua xa NGUNG NHAN PHIEU moi khi mot dich vu cua ben thu ba hong, dung hinh dang ma luat 2 cam #5. Cai gia phai tra nguoc lai chinh la thu duoc chap nhan: co mot khoang cong dan da doi trang thai ma chua duoc bao. Khoang ay chiu duoc vi thu cong dan cam trong tay tu giay dau tien la MA TRA CUU (luat 10 bat bien 1) — ho tra cuu duoc trang thai that ngay ca khi tin nhan chua toi — con thu KHONG chiu duoc la mat han mot lan bao ma khong ai biet, nen cai gia duoc tra bang mot SO ghi nghia vu truoc khi gui, chu khong bang mot bang chi luu tin da gui thanh cong: mot bang nhu the khong co gi de hien cho can bo va khong co gi de thu lai. Ba dieu KHONG duoc 'sua cho an toan' ve sau: (1) doi thanh loi goi gRPC dong bo trong luot tiep nhan — do la dung cai bay o tren; (2) bo `occurrence` khoi su kien vi 'mot phieu chi dong mot lan' — ADR 0008 cho cong dan mo lai phieu, va thieu no thi lan bao thu hai bi nuot, hong ay TRONG Y HET chong trung dung khi nhin tu ben trong; (3) cho comms tu suy ra loi nhan tu ma trang thai — do la mot ban sao danh sach chin trang thai (ADR 0027) song o ben kia ranh gioi service, va no se bi phat hien la da troi dung vao ngay mot chuyen trang thai lang le thoi bao cho ai ca. Mot dieu nua ve luat 3: su kien nay CHAY thu se thanh tin nhan toi mot nguoi that, nen no khong mang so dien thoai, ho ten hay noi dung phan anh — nguoi nhan di duoi dang dinh danh mo, va hang doi thi duoc luu va sao luu vinh vien.
thong_bao_cong_dan_khi_phieu_doi_trang_t.adr: kb/10-decisions/0006-per-commune-zalo-oa.md (he qua 3 va 4 — quyet dinh muc nhat quan) - kb/10-decisions/0008-petition-lifecycle-config.md (cong dan mo lai phieu -> vi sao co `occurrence`) - kb/10-decisions/0027-trang-thai-va-dong-ho-phieu-phan-anh.md (chin trang thai, danh sach dong, do petitions so huu) - kb/10-decisions/0018-oa-xac-thuc-tach-khoi-oa-thong-bao.md (kenh gui la ZNS cua OA xa)

phan_giai_phien_cong_dan_lien_service.scope: Hai service moi yeu cau cua CONG DAN: service-petitions (va moi service khac muon dung ria kenh cong dan) goi IdentityService.ResolveCitizenSession qua core/identityclient.SoPhienCongDan, core/httpx.CitizenEdge dat phien vao context, core/httpx.XaTuPhien lay XA TU PHIEN do. Khong ghi du lieu nghiep vu nao trong buoc nay: RPC chi DOC bang phien_cong_dan. CHUA CHAY DUOC: RPC vang mat trong core/grpcx.methodsWithoutTenant, xem cot vi_sao.
phan_giai_phien_cong_dan_lien_service.compensation: Khong co gi de bu: buoc nay khong ghi. Goi that bai (UNAVAILABLE) thi ben goi PHAI tra 503. HOM NAY NO CHUA LAM DUOC VA DAY LA CHO GHI DIEU DO: core/httpx.CitizenSessions chi co HAI ket qua, nen core/identityclient.SoPhienCongDan buoc phai gop 'identity chet' thanh 'khong co phien' va cong dan nhan 401 'Phien khong hop le hoac da ket thuc' trong khi phien van con nguyen. Duong can bo khong tra gia nay vi staffauth.Resolver co error. Cach sua da biet: cho httpx.CitizenSessions.TraCuu tra them error, dan tu CitizenEdge sang XaTuPhien, them nhanh 503. Dau vet duy nhat con lai trong khi cho: mot dong CANH BAO HA TANG trong core/identityclient/phien_cong_dan.go.
phan_giai_phien_cong_dan_lien_service.why: MANH, VA KHONG CO LUA CHON THU HAI. Day la buoc phan giai XA cho kenh cong dan (ADR 0022): Mini App khong co ten mien nen khong co Host de suy xa, va lay xa tu bat cu thu gi client gui len la luat 1 cam #2. Mot ban sao qua su kien se tra loi bang mot phien da cu — tuc phuc vu du lieu cua mot xa duoi danh nghia mot phien da bi thu hoi, dung dieu luat 5 bat bien 4 va ADR 0019 buoc 6 ('dang xuat man hinh dung chung') cam. KHONG CACHE, cung mot lap luan da viet cho duong can bo va cho chinh kho nay o service-identity/internal/store/phien_cong_dan.go: ADR 0010 chot ha tang chi co PostgreSQL nen khong co cache dung chung, identity chay nhieu replica nen moi cache deu PER PROCESS, va mot lan thu hoi do replica A phuc vu khong co duong nao bao cho replica B. Cai gia da chon: mot vong mang cho MOI yeu cau cua moi cong dan. DIEU KIEN DUNG DANG MO, va luong nay chua chay duoc vi no: RPC KHONG THE mang "x-tenant-id" (no chinh la thu tra loi 'xa nao'), nen phai co ten trong core/grpcx.methodsWithoutTenant — va ADR 0012 quyet dinh 1 noi them mot ten vao danh sach ay la DIEU KIEN DUNG, hoi nguoi dung. Toi khi duoc tra loi, interceptor ben goi tu choi voi InvalidArgument; su vang mat duoc ghim boi core/grpcx/grpcx_test.go va core/identityclient/phien_cong_dan_test.go. MOT DIEU RPC NAY KHONG LAM, noi ro de khong ai suy rong: no phan giai PHIEN, no KHONG cap quyen gi. Danh tinh cong dan la danh tinh yeu (luat 4), nen phan hoi khong mang khoa quyen nao va khong bao gio duoc mang.

phat_hanh_phien_cong_dan_qua_cau_mini_ap.scope: vihat-miniapp (kho thuong mai) doi token Zalo bang app secret cua dung app, roi goi CitizenSessionBridgeService.OpenCitizenSession (proto/vigov/identity/v1/citizen_session_bridge.proto) tren cong rieng cua service-identity. Trong identity: HAI hoac BA lan DOC dong bo sang service-platform TRUOC giao dich (ResolveMiniApp theo app_id; CHI o app chinh co commune_confirmed: ResolveHost theo commune_host_hint — ten mien xa cua QR, ADR 0047 — ra ULID cua xa; GetTenant cua xa se vao, voi xa ay dat vao context), roi MOT giao dich tren CSDL cua identity: upsert tai khoan Zalo (app_id, zalo_user_id) + xa da nho, tim-hoac-tao dinh_danh_cong_dan neu co so dien thoai, khi doi xa (app chinh) thu hoi MOI phien con song cua tai khoan Zalo ay, chen phien_cong_dan, ghi vet. Khong phat su kien, khong ghi sang service nao khac. Da cai dat: service-identity/internal/app/cau_phien_cong_dan.go (migration 0011, chua chay tren PostgreSQL that). Xung dot voi mot lan doi xa khac vua commit -> ABORTED, vihat-miniapp goi lai.
phat_hanh_phien_cong_dan_qua_cau_mini_ap.compensation: Khong co gi de bu, vi moi thu ghi deu nam trong MOT giao dich cua identity: hong la khong co phien, khong co vet, khong doi xa da nho. Platform khong toi duoc (ca ResolveHost) -> UNAVAILABLE -> vihat-miniapp tra 503, KHONG BAO GIO FAILED_PRECONDITION (neu khong mot su co cua platform doc thanh 'xa nay khong ton tai'), KHONG tu phat phien cua minh cho be mat ViGov, KHONG doan xa. Ca con lai da chap nhan: goi lai sau timeout ma lan dau da thanh cong thi con mot phien mo coi (token khong ai giu, chi luu bam SHA-256), het han theo TTL, va nhat ky co hai lan mo phien — chap nhan thay vi dung khoa idempotency, vi token khong doan duoc va vet hai lan la su that.
phat_hanh_phien_cong_dan_qua_cau_mini_ap.why: MANH vi day la luc XA VAO PHIEN — buoc cach ly (luat 1) cua kenh cong dan. Doc app_id -> xa tu mot ban sao qua su kien nghia la mot app vua bi go khoi xa, hoac mot xa vua ngung hoat dong (sap nhap), van tiep tuc phat phien vao xa ay trong khoang tre: phuc vu du lieu cua mot co quan duoi danh nghia mot co quan khac da khong con. Cac lan doc la dong bo va phai thanh cong truoc khi ghi. ResolveHost cung dong bo vi cung ly do: ten mien -> xa doi khi sap nhap (nguoi van hanh tro ten mien cu sang xa ke thua), va mot ban sao tre se dua cong dan vao xa da bi thay. Ten mien CHI la khoa tra: phien, xa da nho va vet chi giu ULID, khong luu ten mien o dau ca (luat 1 cam #5, ADR 0047). App rieng KHONG goi ResolveHost; khong co duong 'platform chet thi dung xa nho lan truoc'. Vet phai cung giao dich voi phien (luat 6 bat bien 3) nen phien, lien ket tai khoan Zalo va xa da nho phai o CUNG mot CSDL — ly do chung thuoc identity, khong thuoc platform hay vihat-miniapp. vihat-miniapp khong giu trang thai nao cua ViGov nen khong co gi phai bu o phia ay.

phat_hanh_phien_cong_dan_app_rieng_qua_i.scope: identity: tra ResolveMiniApp (platform, chi doc) -> doc mini_app_secret trong ngu canh xa -> doi ma Zalo (AccountID roi Phone, chi doc, ben ngoai) -> MOT giao dich identity qua CauPhienCongDan.Mo (tai khoan Zalo, dinh danh, phien, vet kiem toan). Ban demo bo qua Zalo.
phat_hanh_phien_cong_dan_app_rieng_qua_i.compensation: Khong co gi phai bu: moi buoc truoc giao dich chi doc (platform, Zalo); hong o bat ky buoc nao thi tra 4xx/5xx va KHONG ghi gi. Giao dich Mo hong thi cuon lai toan bo. Mot lan thu lai sau khi mat cau tra loi co the de lai mot phien mo coi, het han theo TTL (khong idempotent theo hop dong, giong cau phien).
phat_hanh_phien_cong_dan_app_rieng_qua_i.why: Phien cong dan va vet kiem toan phai cung thanh cong hoac cung khong (luat 6 bat bien 3). Zalo nam ngoai giao dich vi la goi mang ben ngoai; phoneToken co the dung mot lan nen goi sau AccountID va sau khi mo duoc secret.

kiem_bo_phan_va_can_bo_truoc_khi_giao_vi.scope: service-petitions (giao/tao nhiem vu, phan cong phieu phan anh) goi IdentityService.ResolveLiveOrgUnits (ma bo_phan.id trong than yeu cau) va ResolveAssignableStaff (ma can bo) - proto/vigov/identity/v1/identity.proto, nguoi dung chot 28/09/2026 cho vong bo phan, 25/09/2026 cho vong can bo. Hai loi goi la DOC, khong ghi gi; chung nam NGOAI giao dich va phai xong TRUOC khi giao dich cua petitions mo, roi petitions tu ghi ban ghi + dong nhat ky trong MOT giao dich cua chinh no (luat 6 bat bien 3).
kiem_bo_phan_va_can_bo_truoc_khi_giao_vi.compensation: Loi goi that bai (UNAVAILABLE, Internal) thi KHONG ghi: tra 503 co the thu lai, khong bao gio ghi ma bo phan/ma can bo chua kiem. Ma vang mat trong cau tra loi thi tu choi ghi (400/422, 'bo phan nay khong nhan duoc viec'). Khong co gi phai bu vi chua co gi duoc ghi.
kiem_bo_phan_va_can_bo_truoc_khi_giao_vi.why: Manh vi ma bo phan den tu THAN YEU CAU - du lieu ben goi tu khai. Ghi ma chua kiem la de mot yeu cau soan tay giao viec cho bo phan cua XA KHAC, cho bo phan da xoa khoi so do, hoac cho mot ma khong tro vao dau - va viec ay nam do voi khong ai, mai mai, tren mot danh sach khong ai mo (luat 1, luat 2 dieu kien dung #2). Duong SU KIEN + read model cua so do to chuc o petitions bi loai: do tre roi dung vao luc mot bo phan vua bi xoa van nhan viec moi, va mot ban sao so do to chuc o service khac la ban sao thu hai cua mot su that ma identity so huu. Duong petitions tu doc CSDL identity la luat 2 cam #2. Cai gia chap nhan: mot chang mang tren moi lan GHI giao viec (khong phai moi lan doc), va ghi giao viec hong khi identity sap - dung chieu fail closed. Vi tu 'con hieu luc' cua bo phan PHAI trung vi tu cua o chon bo phan (GET /api/v1/org-units): ai doi mot ben doi ca hai trong cung commit.
kiem_bo_phan_va_can_bo_truoc_khi_giao_vi.adr: khong co ADR rieng - ly do nam o chu thich rpc ResolveLiveOrgUnits va ResolveAssignableStaff trong proto/vigov/identity/v1/identity.proto

loc_so_nhiem_vu_theo_cau_hinh_cua_identi.scope: service-petitions, tuyen DOC so nhiem vu (GET /api/v1/tasks, dem theo trang thai): `soon=true` goi IdentityService.ResolveDueSoonCutoff (moc cuoi cua 'sap den han' tinh tu `sla.gio_sap_den_han` cua xa + lich lam viec, tu `now` cua chinh yeu cau), `scope=related` goi IdentityService.ResolveStaffOrgUnits (bo phan cua chinh chu the dang nhap, ma lay tu phien). Moi loi goi chi khi tham so tuong ung duoc hoi; khong ghi gi o ca hai phia.
loc_so_nhiem_vu_theo_cau_hinh_cua_identi.compensation: Loi goi that bai thi TU CHOI trang (503 co the thu lai), khong bao gio tra trang da bo bo loc. Xa chua cau hinh `sla` (FAILED_PRECONDITION - hom nay la MOI xa) thi tra loi noi ro bo loc chua cau hinh cho xa nay, khong thay bang 72 gio va khong lang le bo bo loc.
loc_so_nhiem_vu_theo_cau_hinh_cua_identi.why: Manh vi mot trang loc sai la mot trang TRONG GIONG trang dung: tab 'Lien quan den toi' thieu viec cua bo phan minh, hay danh sach 'Sap den han' thieu mot viec, khong bao gi tu bao loi. Cache bi loai: moc cuoi thay doi theo `now`, va xa sua ngay nghi hay nguong thi lan tai sau phai thay ngay (khong co kenh thu hoi giua cac ban sao, cung ly do phien_cong_dan.go ghi). Tra SO GIO de petitions tu cong bi loai (ADR 0029 Bo sung 22/09/2026): phep cong trong tam tay la gio dong ho, dem ca dem, cuoi tuan, ngay_nghi_le, ngay_lam_bu - luat 10 cam #2. Tinh 'sap den han' KHONG can phep dem nguoc tu tung han: voi moi han D, so gio lam viec con lai <= N tuong duong D <= moc MUON NHAT ma tu `now` da troi qua toi da N gio lam viec - mot phep di xuoi, cung mot cai dat voi moi han trong he thong. Bo phan cua can bo la mot RPC rieng chu khong phai truong tren StaffPrincipal: StaffPrincipal chay tren MOI yeu cau cua bon service, va mot bo phan tren principal la mot buoc cach mot guard 'cung bo phan thi duoc sua' ngoai service so huu quyen (luat 5).

chan_xoa_bo_phan_con_giu_ho_so.scope: service-identity, truoc khi xoa mem mot bo_phan, goi CountOrgUnitHoldings tren service-petitions va service-documents (proto/vigov/{petitions,documents}/v1, d1b43da). Hai loi goi la DOC, nam NGOAI va TRUOC giao dich xoa cua identity; dong xoa mem va dong nhat ky kiem toan ghi trong MOT giao dich identity. Chan khi con (a) can bo dang hoat dong, (b) bo phan con chua xoa — ca hai doc trong CSDL cua identity — hoac (c) ho so con mo qua hai RPC ay. Du an Thu-Chi (du_an.don_vi_thuc_hien_id) KHONG tinh: du an khong co trang thai (nguoi dung chot 28/09/2026).
chan_xoa_bo_phan_con_giu_ho_so.compensation: Loi goi nao that bai thi KHONG xoa (503, thu lai duoc) — loi khong bao gio doc thanh 0. So dem nao lon hon 0 thi 409 kem so dem tung loai de can bo biet phai chuyen gi truoc. Khong co gi de bu vi chua ghi gi. Khoang ho con lai (mot ho so duoc giao ngay sau lan dem) duoc chap nhan: identity chi xoa mem nen ten bo phan van hien, va giao lai van lam duoc. Mo lai mot ho so da ket thuc ve bo phan da xoa la PHAT HIEN, chua dung.
chan_xoa_bo_phan_con_giu_ho_so.why: Manh vi viec xoa khong hoan tac duoc trong nghiep vu va mot ho so con mo nam tren bo phan da xoa lam gay im lang cam ket voi cong dan (luat 10) va ho so luu tru (luat 7). Bi loai: su kien + read model o identity (tre, va la ban sao thu hai cua su that petitions/documents so huu — luat 9); identity doc thang CSDL cua ho (luat 2 cam #2); khoa phan tan (them mot loi goi vao moi lan giao viec cho mot khoang ho khong ai do duoc). Chieu phu thuoc identity -> petitions/documents la moi; khong thanh vong luc khoi dong vi grpc.NewClient noi luoi; cai gia la xoa bo phan that bai khi mot trong hai service sap — dung chieu hong dong.

in_so_theo_doi_nhiem_vu_xlsx.scope: service-petitions, tuyen DOC xuat So theo doi nhiem vu ra .xlsx o may chu (docs/ui-ux/02-nhiem-vu.md §4.3). Doi ten tu identity bang ba loi goi theo lo, moi lo toi da 200 khoa: ResolveOrgUnitNames (bo_phan_id, co_quan_chu_tri_id -> ten, KE CA bo phan da xoa mem, danh dau REMOVED), ResolveTaskBlocLabels (nhiem_vu.khoi -> nhan, ke ca dong da xoa), ResolveStaffNames (ma can bo -> ho ten). Khong ghi gi o ca hai phia.
in_so_theo_doi_nhiem_vu_xlsx.compensation: Loi goi nao that bai thi KHONG xuat tep (503, thu lai duoc) — khong bao gio in o trong o cho ten. Khoa vang mat trong cau tra loi (khong co / xa khac) la chuyen thuong: in khoa tho hoac 'khong ro', khong bao gio in o trong. Khong co gi de bu.
in_so_theo_doi_nhiem_vu_xlsx.why: Manh (goi dong bo luc xuat) vi ban in la ho so luu tru: mot o 'Don vi thuc hien' trong la mot dong khong ro ai chiu trach nhiem (luat 6, luat 7). Ban sao ten bo phan/nhan khoi qua su kien o petitions bi loai: la ban sao thu hai cua su that identity so huu (luat 9), va do tre in ten cu sau khi xa doi ten. Doc thang CSDL identity la luat 2 cam #2. Tra ca dong DA XOA la co y: nhiem vu van giu id cua bo phan da go, va ban in phai ghi dung dieu ho so giu — vi the day la RPC rieng, khong phai ResolveLiveOrgUnits (duong ben goi QUYET DINH ghi). Ten in ra la ten HOM NAY cua bo phan/khoi ay; ho so khong luu ten luc tao. Cai gia: xuat tep hong khi identity sap — dung chieu hong dong.
in_so_theo_doi_nhiem_vu_xlsx.adr: khong co ADR rieng - ly do nam o chu thich rpc ResolveOrgUnitNames va ResolveTaskBlocLabels trong proto/vigov/identity/v1/identity.proto

nhap_nhiem_vu_xlsx_tra_ma_bo_phan.scope: service-petitions, nhap nhiem vu tu Excel: can bo go MA bo phan (bo_phan.ma, slug), nhiem vu luu bo_phan.id. Petitions goi IdentityService.ResolveLiveOrgUnitCodes (toi da 200 ma moi lo) NGOAI va TRUOC giao dich ghi cua minh; ban ghi nhiem vu va dong nhat ky ghi trong MOT giao dich petitions.
nhap_nhiem_vu_xlsx_tra_ma_bo_phan.compensation: Loi goi that bai thi KHONG nhap (503, thu lai duoc) — khong bao gio doc thanh 'ma bo phan khong ton tai' va khong bao gio ghi ma chua kiem. Ma vang mat (khong co / da xoa / xa khac — mot cau tra loi) thi tu choi dong ay, khong ghi voi bo phan trong va khong so theo ten. Khong co gi de bu vi chua ghi gi.
nhap_nhiem_vu_xlsx_tra_ma_bo_phan.why: Manh vi id tra ve duoc GHI len nhiem vu: vi tu 'con hieu luc' phai trung vi tu cua ResolveLiveOrgUnits va o chon bo phan (hang liveOrgUnit trong store identity), neu khong thi tep nhap giao duoc viec cho bo phan ma giao tay bi tu choi. Ma bo phan la slug DOAN DUOC, nhung chi lo cho ben goi dieu GET /api/v1/org-units da cho moi tai khoan cua xa thay; cat theo xa (x-tenant-id) la cai giu so do to chuc cua XA KHAC kin (luat 1). Ban sao so do o petitions bi loai vi cung ly do kiem_bo_phan_va_can_bo_truoc_khi_giao_viec ghi. Tran 200 thay vi 50: mot lan nhap la nhieu lan giao viec, so ma khac nhau bi chan boi so do to chuc chu khong boi mot bieu mau.
nhap_nhiem_vu_xlsx_tra_ma_bo_phan.adr: khong co ADR rieng - ly do nam o chu thich rpc ResolveLiveOrgUnitCodes trong proto/vigov/identity/v1/identity.proto

chay_tac_vu_tu_dong_theo_xa.scope: Ba tac vu Tu dong hoa (docs/ui-ux/14-cau-hinh.md §9: sla_reminders, escalation, weekly_digest) chay TRONG TIEN TRINH cua service so huu du lieu — service-petitions (NHIEM_VU, PHAN_ANH) va service-documents (VAN_BAN_DEN, DON_THU — don thu them 29/09/2026, migration identity 0016). Moi nhip, voi tung xa ma service ay dang giu du lieu (doc id xa o kho cua chinh no, co // @cross-tenant:), va xa ay active theo platform GetTenant: (1) IdentityService.ClaimDueAutomationRuns — identity quyet dinh 'toi luot chua' va GIANH luot bang mot lenh ghi co dieu kien; (2) doc ban ghi cua minh; ResolveDueSoonCutoff / ResolveEscalationInstants / ResolveUnassignedHoldInstants / ResolveOrgUnitPermissionHolders / ResolveLeadershipStaff; (3) CommsService.DeliverStaffNotifications — mot giao dich comms: cac dong hop thu + MOT dong nhat ky he thong; (4) IdentityService.RecordAutomationRunOutcome — mot giao dich identity: ket qua + MOT dong nhat ky he thong. Moi loi goi mang x-tenant-id cua dung xa dang chay. Bon buoc, ba service, KHONG co giao dich chung.
chay_tac_vu_tu_dong_theo_xa.max_lag: mot nhip cua bo chay (5 phut) cong nhip cua tac vu ma xa dat; luot lo vi khong ai go nhip chay DUNG MOT LAN o nhip ke tiep
chay_tac_vu_tu_dong_theo_xa.compensation: Khong co buoc nao can hoan tac, vi moi buoc deu lap lai duoc hoac bo qua duoc: (a) gianh luot roi chet giua chung -> luot ay khong co ket qua (man cau hinh hien dung nhu the), luot sau lam lai; thong bao da gui khong gui lai nho khoa idempotency theo NGHIEP VU (khong theo run_id); (b) comms hong -> khong dong nao ghi, ket qua DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, luot sau thu lai; (c) identity tra FAILED_PRECONDITION (xa chua cau hinh sla/lich) -> KHONG bao ai tu mot con so mac dinh, ket qua CONFIGURATION_MISSING de quan tri xa sua; (d) ghi ket qua hong -> thu lai an toan, ban ghi dau tien thang.
chay_tac_vu_tu_dong_theo_xa.why: Cuoi cung vi day la NHAC VIEC, khong phai ghi ho so: khong buoc nao doi trang thai mot van ban, phieu hay nhiem vu, nen mot thong bao den tre vai phut khong de lai ho so nao o trang thai luat luu tru khong cho phep (luat 2 bat bien 6). Giao dich phan tan qua ba service de 'gui dung mot lan' la mua bang dong bo mot dieu khoa idempotency da mua re hon (luat 2 bat bien 5). Gianh luot o identity thay vi tung service tu tinh 'toi luot' vi hai service va nhieu replica: hai ban cai dat cua mot lich chay se lech dung o phut mo nhip va ngay bat tac vu, va hai replica cung doc cai dat se cung chay. Khong co RPC 'xa nao dang bat tac vu X' vi no la mot doc xuyen xa di khong x-tenant-id — them ten vao core/grpcx.methodsWithoutTenant la DIEU KIEN DUNG cua ADR 0012 quyet dinh 1 — va cau tra loi la danh sach ULID cua moi xa. Moc neo leo thang = HAN DA LO, dem xuoi bang gio lam viec o identity (mot ban cai dat, ADR 0007); khong co phep dem nguoc nen khong co 'moc cat' kieu ResolveDueSoonCutoff. Nguong 'bo phan giu viec chua giao ai' (sla.unassigned_hold_hours) dung CUNG phep dem xuoi, neo tai luc bo phan bat dau giu viec chua giao (su that cua service chay), la RPC rieng ResolveUnassignedHoldInstants vi khac moc neo va khac tac vu; NULL = xa chon KHONG bao, tra reporting_disabled chu khong phai mot con so mac dinh. Cai gia: moi nhip moi xa hai loi goi (GetTenant + Claim) cho moi service chay; xa khong co ban ghi nao o service do thi khong nhan ban tin tuan tu service do.
chay_tac_vu_tu_dong_theo_xa.adr: kb/10-decisions/0058-automation-jobs-in-owning-service.md; ly do hop dong nam o chu thich rpc ClaimDueAutomationRuns, ResolveEscalationInstants, ResolveUnassignedHoldInstants trong proto/vigov/identity/v1/identity.proto va DeliverStaffNotifications trong proto/vigov/comms/v1/comms.proto

tao_nhiem_vu_tu_phieu_phan_anh.scope: MOT giao dich trong service-petitions: doc lai phieu FOR UPDATE (tu choi linh vuc can-bo; chi da-chuyen-xu-ly/dang-xu-ly/da-xu-ly/cho-dan-xac-nhan va da co linh vuc), tao nhiem vu (nguon_giao=phan-anh, nguon_id do MAY CHU dat), dong dong thoi gian nhiem vu, vet tao_nhiem_vu, dong nhat ky phieu hanh_vi=tao-nhiem-vu, vet tao_nhiem_vu_tu_phan_anh (chu the = ma tra cuu). POST /api/v1/citizen-reports/{maTraCuu}/tasks.
tao_nhiem_vu_tu_phieu_phan_anh.compensation: Khong co — mot giao dich: bat ky buoc nao hong thi quay lui ca nhiem vu lan dong nhat ky; phieu bi dong xen giua thi lan doc FOR UPDATE thua va tu choi 409 petition_state.
tao_nhiem_vu_tu_phieu_phan_anh.why: Nhiem vu va phieu cung service petitions nen mot giao dich la re nhat va dung nhat. Nguoi dung chot 30/09/2026 (ADR khong can): may chu tu gan nguon vi POST /tasks nhan source_id khong kiem da bi chan tu 2d34eba4 (co the tro phieu xa khac hoac phieu can-bo). Mot nhiem vu ma khong co dong nhat ky phieu la trang thai quy dinh luu tru khong cho phep (luat 2).

nhan_dien_xa_anh_cong_khai.scope: MOT service (platform), mot giao dich PostgreSQL cho moi lan hoan tat: stored_file len ready + public_object_key + ho_so_hien_thi_xa.{logo_file_id|web_admin_banner_file_id} + audit_log. Kho doi tuong (MinIO) KHONG giao dich: PublishDerivative (chep ban dan xuat sang bucket public) chay BEN TRONG giao dich khi dong stored_file dang bi khoa FOR UPDATE; go ban cong khai cu (UnpublishDerivative) chay SAU commit. Ma: service-platform/internal/app/branding.go.
nhan_dien_xa_anh_cong_khai.compensation: (1) Giao dich hong SAU khi da chep: undoPublish mo mot giao dich ngan, khoa lai dong FOR UPDATE, va chi go ban cong khai khi dong KHONG mang public_object_key (khoa da ghi = mot lan hoan tat khac cung tep da commit va so huu ban sao — khong bao gio go). Go hong thi ghi log theo khoa doi tuong (khong du lieu ca nhan): ban sao mo coi chi toi duoc bang khoa — hai ULID ngau nhien — va bucket public khong liet ke duoc (ADR 0052 §2). (2) Thay hoac go anh: ho so tro sang anh moi (hoac NULL) va vet ghi CUNG giao dich, nen anh cu thoi la anh HIEN TAI ngay khi commit. Sau commit: UnpublishDerivative, roi mot giao dich ngan xoa public_object_key + xoa mem dong (deleted_by ma CB-, delete_reason) + vet go_ban_cong_khai_anh_nhan_dien_cu. Bat ky buoc nao hong thi public_object_key VAN GIU — dau ben vung 'co the con ban cong khai' — va lan dat/go ke tiep cua cung anh doc PublishedOfPurpose va thu lai. Khong bao gio xoa cung.
nhan_dien_xa_anh_cong_khai.why: Luu la hien (ADR 0069 #3): khong co buoc duyet sau, nen cong khai phai nam trong cung hanh vi voi viec tro ho so, neu khong se co 'ho so tro toi anh chua cong khai' (trigger 0017 cung cam) hoac 'anh cong khai ma ho so khong tro toi'. Chep TRONG giao dich vi chep hong thi tu choi sach (503, khong ghi gi); go SAU commit vi viec doi anh hien tai khong duoc doi kho doi tuong. Khoa giu trong luc chep mot ban PNG/JPEG da chuan hoa (vai tram KB), khong bao gio trong luc quet ma doc hay giai ma — hai viec ay chay ngoai giao dich, khe giai ma co han cho 10 giay roi tra 503. Gia phai tra, noi ro: trinh duyet/CDN da tai anh cu co the giu toi mot nam (storage.PublicCacheControl) — vi vay moi lan tai len la mot khoa moi, khong bao gio ghi de byte sau khoa cu. retain_until cua anh bi thay de NULL: ADR 0052 Con mo #1 chua chot.
